text.en:
Executive Order No. 493, (s. 2006) creating the Inter-Agency Legal
Action Group (IALAG) is hereby revoked.

Executive officials and employees can no longer make use of Executive
Order No. 493 (s. 2006) in the investigation, prosecution and monitoring of offenses
relating to national security.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of May , in the year of our Lord,
Two Thousand and Nine.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA HOlogram « 49100
